name: Unara
role: the Lord-Marshal's quartermaster, stripped and in irons
backstory: Eleven years Lorard's quartermaster, Unara sent Ashlo to make a spark at the forge so the search would have cause, believing the Marshal's claim was nothing without the Coal. A woman in grey had promised the Pyrehouse would open to him. Lorard stripped her rank on the spot; her own company will try her.

relationships.name: Lorard Hask
relationships.how: served him eleven years; he put her in irons
